summary.name: Flowise
summary.one_liner: Flowise is an open source generative AI development platform with a drag-and-drop visual builder for creating AI agents, multi-agent systems, chatbots and LLM apps.
use_cases: Building a no-code chatbot that answers questions from PDFs or documents
Orchestrating multiple coordinated AI agents in a workflow
Adding human review steps to agent tasks
Embedding an AI chat widget into a website
Deploying LLM apps on cloud or on-premises infrastructure
Monitoring agent executions with tracing tools
summary.what_it_does: Flowise provides modular building blocks for creating agentic systems, from simple workflows to autonomous agents, through a visual drag-and-drop interface. It supports multi-agent workflow orchestration and single-agent chat assistants with tool calling and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over various data sources. Humans can be included in the loop to review agent tasks. The page says it offers full execution traces with Prometheus and OpenTelemetry support, plus APIs, a TypeScript and Python SDK, and an embeddable chat widget for integration into applications. It is installable via npm (npm install -g flowise, then npx flowise start) and lists 100+ LLMs, embeddings and vector DBs for production deployment with horizontal scaling via message queues and workers.
notable: Open source drag-and-drop UI built on LangChain
Full execution traces with Prometheus and OpenTelemetry support
Embeddable chat widget plus TypeScript and Python SDKs
caveats: Page says 'Start building for free' and offers scaled tiers and an enterprise option, but specific prices are not shown on the page
